The capacity is `(mrb_int)(b - a) + 1`, but the loop can write more elements than this capacity. This happens when `b - a` has a fractional part that gets truncated by the cast to `mrb_int`, but the loop still iterates `floor(b - a) + 1` or more times.

ary = mrb_ary_new_capa(mrb, (mrb_int)(b - a) + 1);
```

The capacity is `(mrb_int)(b - a) + 1`, but the loop can write more elements than this capacity. This happens when `b - a` has a fractional part that gets truncated by the cast to `mrb_int`, but the loop still iterates `floor(b - a) + 1` or more times.

For example, `(0.3..2.3).to_a`:
- `b - a = 2.3 - 0.3 = 1.9999999999999998` (floating point)
- `(mrb_int)(1.9999999999999998) = 1`
- capacity = 2
- Loop: 0.3, 1.3, 2.3 = 3 iterations → writes 3 elements into capacity-2 array → heap-buffer-overflow
